home_faq_free_question: Can I generate an AI video for free without signing up?
home_faq_free_answer: Yes. The daily free trial is available without an account when allowance remains. Select a trial model to see its settings. Daily limit per device: {count}, shared before and after sign-in. Allowances reset at 00:00 UTC; network limits and daily availability also apply. Eligible new verified accounts can receive one additional registration trial voucher.
home_faq_watermark_question: Do free video downloads have a watermark?
home_faq_watermark_answer: Free AI Video adds no watermark to daily free trials, registration-voucher videos or credit-paid videos. There is no separate export fee.
home_faq_model_question: Which AI video models can I use?
home_faq_model_answer: The generator offers 30 models for credit videos. Six are eligible for free trials: Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0 Mini, MiniMax H3, Kling 2.6, Grok Imagine Video and Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash. Select a model to see its available settings.
home_faq_photo_question: Can I turn a photo into a video?
home_faq_photo_answer: Yes. Add a reference image and describe the motion you want. Image support and aspect ratio options depend on the selected model.
home_faq_duration_question: How long are the generated videos?
home_faq_duration_answer: Trial videos use the selected model’s trial settings, shown in the generator. Credit video duration, resolution and price depend on your selection.
home_faq_aspect_question: Which aspect ratios can I use?
home_faq_aspect_answer: Available aspect ratios depend on the model and are shown in the generator. Some models automatically determine the aspect ratio when a reference image is used.
home_faq_failure_question: What happens if a video render fails?
home_faq_failure_answer: For a credit-paid request, a confirmed rejection before submission or a settled provider charge of zero is eligible for a credit return. If billing cannot yet be confirmed, the status remains pending and credits are not yet returned. If the provider has charged, credits are not automatically returned. Check the task status and contact support with its ID instead of resubmitting while it is pending. Free daily trials and registration vouchers are counted when a request is accepted; failure or cancellation does not automatically restore the allowance. Purchase refunds follow the separate refund policy.

It is used when a generation request is accepted, including if the request later fails or is cancelled. Previously issued credits remain in the account under their existing terms.
